verdict.rationale: skills.sh ships an official `npx skills` CLI with extensive documented subcommands (add, use, list, find, update, remove, init) and hands-on runtime probes confirming it works keylessly and non-interactively, matching an AI-native, agentic workflow. missing for 10: independent third-party review of long-term CLI stability/versioning practices beyond community complaints about package-management maturity.
